For the plan: (a) test__affected_tests.py now calls _output.py_files, so it is itself a derived tree scanner (it appears in --list-scanners). outcome.descriptive: A task's gate no longer pulls in every whole-tree scanner for any .py change. Those suites and tools run in the phase gate's unscoped sweep and verify.sh's per-run tier, and cases keep that true.
